annotation.title_clean: ISO/DIS 21734-2 Intelligent transport systems — Performance testing for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses in public transport — Part 2: Performance requirements and test procedure
annotation.title_en: ISO/DIS 21734-2 Intelligent transport systems — Performance testing for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses in public transport — Part 2: Performance requirements and test procedure
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for draft international standard ISO/DIS 21734-2, developed by ISO/TC 204, setting performance requirements and test procedures for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses in public transport. It is in the DIS enquiry phase (stage 40.60).
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies performance requirements for connectivity and safety functions of automated driving buses
Defines a performance test method and procedure for safe public transport operation
Intended for public transport operators and bus information and management centres
Currently at DIS ballot stage, close of voting 2026-05-09
